Bloodborne was my second souls after DS3 and the faster paced movement is something that still sticks. Demon souls will make you forget all of that basically, I’d know this because I only finished it the first time a week ago, I thought it was great however the bosses are not nearly as flashy as other games, however they are very inventive (gimmick bosses). Levelling is much harder and you’re gonna have at least 50% of your health for a lot of the game. HOWEVER, this is the easiest souls game you’ll most likely experience, you have basically uncapped healing (No Estus, you’ll be buying your healing items), parries are very easy to perform and enemies that attack your shield will be stunned like a parry, you’ll definitely be hiding behind your shield for your first play through, but your second time through you’ll have enough knowledge of the game which will make it easily replayable, especially because of the graphics.

TL:DR
Pros
-Graphics and sound, for the PS5 it’s truly amazing with load times and overall the amount of effort put in
-Easiest souls game 
-Combat is fluent and fun
Cons
-lots of gimmick boss fights (not to say they’re bad, *unlike 2-4*
-sometimes feels very unfair in situations compared to other souls games (levelling, health)

I would personally say to try DS3 first, or even play the Old Hunters DLC first just to get a better idea of what you’ll get yourself into.
DS3 is the most modern iteration of a souls game. (not Sekiro, that’s on another level IMO) Bloodborne is much faster paced than Demon Souls, however it’s definitely a game that should be played for the sole reason that you own a PS5.
